description: This file declares the IServiceContext interface within the rialto::servermanager::service namespace. It provides a pure virtual method to access a session server application manager, serving as a context interface for server management components.

classes.name: IServiceContext
classes.description: An interface class providing access to session server application management within the server manager service context.

methods.name: getSessionServerAppManager
methods.description: Pure virtual method to retrieve a reference to the session server application manager.
